visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person's hand holds a red rectangular plastic card featuring the number 65 in bold white text. A staff member wearing a grey t-shirt and blue jeans stands behind a stainless steel counter, extending his hand. The background reveals a busy kitchen environment with pink plastic bags, scissors, and various utensils. (2) The camera captures the exterior of a traditional eatery under a corrugated metal roof. A blue metal sign displays the address 永平街 41. Customers are seated at red folding tables inside the dimly lit interior, while a large white evaporative cooler operates near the entrance. (3) A close-up shot shows a hand using a pencil to mark items on a detailed white paper ordering form. The form contains columns for different types of noodles and soups. The lighting is bright and focused on the paper, highlighting the grid lines and Chinese characters. (4) Multiple close-up shots showcase a bowl of clear pork tongue vermicelli. A silver spoon scoops the broth, and chopsticks lift glistening, translucent noodles. A slice of pork tongue is dipped into a small green saucer containing a mixture of dark soy paste and red chili sauce. (5) A bowl of rice topped with savory braised meat and a sunny-side-up egg is presented. Wooden chopsticks pierce the vibrant orange egg yolk, causing it to flow over the meat and rice. A large spoonful of the glistening, yellow-coated rice is lifted towards the camera. (6) A thick, starchy meat soup with chunks of meat and cilantro is shown in a ceramic bowl. Dark vinegar is poured into the soup from a white plastic container. A small side plate holds slices of cooked pork heart garnished with thin strips of fresh ginger. (7) The video concludes with shots of the shop's interior and various overhead signs. Large white boards with bold red and blue text advertise Authentic Old Shop and Pork Heart Vermicelli. The environment is typical of a local Taiwanese street food stall with bustling energy.
